name: npm lifecycle command
description: An install lifecycle script can run commands before the developer starts the app.

name: npm lifecycle network call
description: An install script can fetch data from a web address.

name: VS Code folder task
description: A VS Code task marked folderOpen can run when a folder is opened.

name: encoded JavaScript
description: A long encoded string can make JavaScript harder to inspect.

name: dynamic code evaluation
description: Evaluating a string as code can hide behavior until runtime.

name: disguised font
description: A file named like a font can contain JavaScript instead of font bytes.

name: asset read and evaluation
description: Code can read text from an image or font path and evaluate it.

name: raw IP contact
description: A script can contact a raw IP address instead of a named host.

name: alternate npm registry
description: An npm configuration can redirect package downloads to another registry.

name: repository dependency
description: A package dependency can come directly from a GitHub repository.
